name: B10-0309/2026 (S&D) – Russia’s unacceptable provocative actions and drone incursions into Romania, the Baltic states and Finland
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on Russia’s unacceptable provocative actions and drone incursions into Romania, the Baltic states and Finland
part_text:
The European Parliament condemns Russia for sending drones into Romania, Estonia, Latvia, Lithuania and Finland, and says Russia is responsible for civilian injuries and damage. It asks the EU to spend more on defence, build joint systems to detect and stop drones along the eastern border, set up a Black Sea security centre, and help border regions hurt by lost tourism and investment. It is an opinion and a set of requests; it does not change any law by itself.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet; it asks for more defence spending, joint counter-drone systems and a Black Sea security hub.
- **Who it affects:** People and businesses in eastern border regions of Romania, the Baltics and Finland.
- **What happens next:** The text goes to EU governments, the Commission and NATO; they decide whether to act.
